tagline: A browser-based workbench for building and exploring layered 2.5D game worlds
short_description: A collection of browser-based experiments for testing sprites, depth sorting, terrain layers, water, and interactive coastal scenes on an orthogonal grid.
long_description: Oblique is a static, browser-based workbench for exploring 2.5D game worlds on an orthogonal square grid. Its standalone experiments include a model sandbox for editing sprites and anchors, inspecting Y-depth sorting and collisions, painting terrain, and exploring a scene; a terrain-layer prototype for procedural substrates, water, and shoreline foam; and a larger Beach Camp coastal scene. The sandbox includes player movement, wandering NPCs, shadows, camera controls, and debug overlays. A companion Sprites workshop previews GLB/glTF turntable views and animation frames and exports sprite sheets or cropped sprites for use in scenes.
notes: Repository README describes a browser-based 2.5D game-world workbench with three featured live prototypes. Static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript; GitHub Pages deploys the repository root. The related Sprites model-to-sprite workshop is hosted at sprites.livive.net.
